- Next: GATE-ONLINE-EFE PASSED 2026-08-18 on mc_blind_L C1 seed 0: goal reached in 36.7 s, 0.121 m final error, no collision, 818 of 861 timesteps with an accepted camera correction, and minimum fused availability 0.0014 along the executed path, so the run entered ground where the arms differ. | EXP-AVAIL-SOURCE | COMPLETE | pooled held-out Brier score of usable-observation probability under leave-one-spatial-block-out, then longest continuous unobserved stretch along the selected route | The two-world governance blocker is CLOSED: that rule was retired 2026-08-20, so a source comparison run in warehouse_full_4cam needs no exception. The F07 contract now treats CAD as a surveyed reference baseline rather than an assumed upper bound: monocular depth ties the CAD raycast on paired held-out Brier (difference 0.0060, better in 8 of 24 folds, sign test p 0.15). Three sub-results, all complete. E1: a Gaussian process with no geometric mean function barely beats the constant baseline on ground it has not seen, so the geometry carries the prediction. E2: geometry predicts availability at rank correlation 0.82 to 0.84 and conditional error at only 0.10 to 0.23, and the most-available camera is not the most accurate at 42.2 percent of positions covered by two or more cameras, which rebuilds the EXP-PRECISION mechanism on current inputs without any per-camera-versus-pooled R_cond claim. E3, under the 0.25 m keep-in contract: on mc_blind_L a 0.16 m sidestep removes the blind route's 5.60 s unobserved stretch entirely and lifts the realised hit rate from 64.1 to 84.1 percent, while terminal sigma moves 0.6 mm across arms, so terminal sigma must never be a closed-loop endpoint. The effect is confined to two tasks of four, which is why the 2026-08-15 pilot could not discriminate. WITHDRAWN by the clearance fix: the claim that a weak availability field routes WORSE than ignoring availability, which was an artifact of boundary-hugging routes; distance-only and FOV/range now tie the blind baseline at 2.40 s and are worse only on the negative-control task. NEW: the benefit depends on camera PLACEMENT rather than count, two opposing cameras giving the largest saving of any configuration (3.40 s) and two on the same wall the smallest (1.50 s) despite a worse blind baseline. NEW LIMITATION: prediction parity is not decision parity, since monocular depth ties the CAD raycast on held-out Brier yet spends an equal-length detour in the wrong place on mc_blind_L and stays exposed 4.80 s against CAD's 0.00 s. The R1 route archetype binding for mc_blind_L is NOT certified: measured detour is about 2 percent against the roughly 27 percent in 06_world_camera_design section 5, because the candidate set is grid Dijkstra rather than lane-graph enumeration. E3 route search was corrected on 2026-08-17 to run on the driveable mask eroded by the 0.25 m global keep-in contract: the previous version searched the raw binary mask, which has no clearance term, and selected routes with 0.062 m and 0.005 m minimum clearance that the local controller would reject at step zero and that E4 would have seeded its planner from. The erosion keeps 64.9 percent of the floor and leaves every task connected at 0.293 to 0.458 m. |
